description: This Java source file defines the FuelAutoTune enum implementing FuelAutoLogic, containing methods for fuel auto-tuning algorithms including processing data points, optimizing table cells, and smoothing deviations, used in automotive ECU tuning.

classes.name: FuelAutoTune
classes.description: Enum singleton implementing fuel auto-tuning logic with methods for processing AFR data and optimizing fuel maps.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process AFR data points, optimize fuel map, and return results.

methods.name: getTotalDeviationAfterCellOptimization
methods.description: Optimizes a single cell in the fuel map to minimize deviation.

methods.name: countDeviation
methods.description: Calculates deviations of AFR data points from target AFR over the fuel map.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Applies smoothing to the deviation map to enforce smoothness constraints.
